issues: Verses 23–24 summarize bondage and deliverance without specifying when or where those events occur; the scene appropriately leaves those details unspecified, but should not be staged as a distinct present-time event.
The summary and narration present the discovery and promise as one scene without specifying their sequence; the source reports these events in order, and the promise follows the discovery of Helam.

The summary combines distinct movements into one scene; ensure the guards remain at Helam while the remainder go to Nephi, and show some returning later with the guards’ wives and children. The quoted narration is a direct excerpt from Mosiah 23:37.
